prior_inspection: All classes previously inspected. Development analysis only.
target: Equal-player observed rookie pressure rate in retained eligible cohort.
primary: Inner-selected residual family with paired one-standard-error preference for zero versus independently tuned conventional ridge.

corrections.residuals: Player-separated cross-fitted baseline predictions, tuning baseline only on each cross-fit training partition
corrections.screening: No outcome-based feature screening or PCA
corrections.reliability: Training-player/drill repeated attempts only; one minus pooled within-player variance over total source variance, clipped to [0,1]. Not physiological calibration
corrections.selection: Three player/class-stratified inner folds; pooled equal-player MSE; choose zero if best paired improvement does not exceed one standard error

evaluation.development: Three class-stratified 4-fold outer repeats on 2023/2024, seeds 714,914,1114
evaluation.temporal: 2023 to 2024 and 2023+2024 to exploratory 2025, tuned on training players only
evaluation.uncertainty: Class-stratified paired player bootstrap of repeat-averaged outer losses; fixed predictions. Separate training-player bootstrap full refits for both temporal comparisons; duplicate identities kept together
evaluation.failures: Retain all families, class errors, fallback frequencies, seed instability, missingness and reliability support
evaluation.no_claim: Zero fallback does not guarantee unseen-risk dominance; no untouched confirmation or deployment claim
